author: KEXP
description: Evoking a nostalgic 2000s dance-rock sound, the Bremerton, Washington-based six-piece Russian Blue send listeners on a rhythmic journey in our latest in-studio session. With host Eva Walker, the band shares a performance of "HANDS!" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Russian Blue performs "HANDS!" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
